```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

counties <- tigris::counties(
  cb = TRUE,
  year = 2025,
  class = "sf"
)

# Project to meters before calculating centroids
counties_proj <- st_transform(counties, 5070)

# Calculate county centroids
centroids <- st_centroid(counties_proj)

# Convert centroids back to longitude/latitude
centroids <- st_transform(centroids, 4326)

# Extract coordinates
coords <- st_coordinates(centroids)

# Create location dataset
county_locations <- counties %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(
    GEOID,
    STATEFP,
    COUNTYFP,
    county = NAME,
    STUSPS,
    longitude = coords[, 1],
    latitude = coords[, 2]
  )
```

```{r}
touch_list <- st_touches(counties_proj)

# Create unique pairs (avoid A-B and B-A duplicates)
pair_list <- lapply(seq_along(touch_list), function(i) {

  neighbors <- touch_list[[i]]
  neighbors <- neighbors[neighbors > i]

  if (length(neighbors) == 0) return(NULL)

  data.frame(
    county1 = counties$GEOID[i],
    county2 = counties$GEOID[neighbors]
  )
})

county_pairs <- bind_rows(pair_list)

write.csv(county_pairs, "Bordering Counties.csv")
write.csv(county_locations, "US Counties.csv")
```
